description: This file defines a custom exception class named ChargeNotFoundException, which extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException. It is used to signal that a charge with a specific ID was not found in the system.

classes.name: ChargeNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a charge was not found; extends AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException.

methods.name: ChargeNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating a charge with the given ID does not exist.

methods.name: ChargeNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with an underlying data access exception.
